name: Pearl Salve
description: Smooth a pearl of soul force over a bruised soul so the ache of the ally fades at once.

name: Tender Pulse
description: Send one soft pulse into a patient and read how it returns to learn where the soul is tender.

name: Calm Lattice
description: Hold a loose lattice of soul force over a hurt ally that spreads any strike across its many cells.

name: Rousing Spark
description: Flick a spark of soul force into a drowsy ally until the ally's mind sharpens.

name: Deep Mend
description: Sink soul force below the surface of a wounded soul and knit the deep tears of the ally layer by layer.

name: Taint Rinse
description: Wash a lingering taint out of an ally's soul with a steady rinse of clean soul force.

name: Quilted Ward
description: Pad a hurt ally's soul with layers of soft force so each blow lands dulled.

name: Wick Trim
description: Pinch away the charred end of a guttering soul so its light steadies in the ally.

name: Fever Siphon
description: Draw the heat of a spirit fever through the healer's palm and out of an ally.

name: Temper Reading
description: Listen to the colour of a patient's soul to judge whether fear or grief is the deeper wound.

name: Bracing Word
description: Speak one level word while pushing soul force into an ally who has begun to sag.

name: Spirit Splint
description: Lay rigid bars of soul force along a cracked soul so the ally can move while the break sets.

name: Mending Fill
description: Pour soul force into a hollow left by a hard blow until the ally's soul is whole again.

name: Dust Brush
description: Sweep a fine brush of soul force across an ally's soul to lift the light dust of strain.

name: Mote Check
description: Scan a patient's soul for stray motes of foreign force that cloud its glow.

name: Clean Pour
description: Pour a thin stream of clear soul force through a fouled soul until it runs bright in the ally.

name: Haze Parting
description: Part the haze that settles on a dazed soul with two sweeping hands until the ally sees plainly.

name: Limpid Guard
description: Hold a clear sheet of soul force before a cleansed ally so no new residue clings.

name: Bright Rally
description: Kindle a bright steady light in a tired ally's soul to carry the ally through a long day.

name: Spirit Rinse
description: Flush every trace of strain residue from an ally's soul in a single rinse.

name: Residue Lifting
description: Lift a thick crust of foreign residue from an ally's soul a little at a time without tearing it.

name: Graft Reading
description: Probe the edges of a soul tear to judge which side will take a graft in the patient.

name: Bud Salve
description: Dab a green salve of soul force on a raw edge so a new bud of soul grows over it.

name: Seed Warmth
description: Hold a small seed of warm soul force against a damaged place until it begins to grow in the ally.

name: Rootbed Hold
description: Sink a root of soul force beneath a grafted place to give the ally's soul something to hold.

name: Rind Guard
description: Wrap a graft in a rough bark of soul force so a blow cannot tear it from the ally.

name: Scion Touch
description: Press a cutting of the healer's own soul force to a wound so it takes root in the ally.

name: Fine Joining
description: Bring the two lips of a torn soul together with fingers of soul force and hold them until they fuse.

name: Soul Graft
description: Bind a living strand of the healer's soul force into a missing stretch of an ally's soul.

name: Living Splice
description: Splice two parted ends of an ally's soul with a braid of soul force that thickens as it sets.

name: Blight Easing
description: Coax a creeping blight out of an ally's soul with warm even strokes until the spreading stops.

name: Calm Tonic
description: Steep a mild tonic of soul force and let an ally drink it in until the spirit settles.

name: Dose Reading
description: Judge how much healing force a patient's soul can take before it begins to strain.

name: Remedy Canopy
description: Draw a soft cover of soul force over a patient so the remedy can work undisturbed.

name: Tonic Lift
description: Raise an ally's soul strength with a measured drip of force that leaves no crash behind.

name: Quiet Remedy
description: Give an ally a slow remedy of soul force over many breaths until the soul has fully mended.

name: Venom Drawing
description: Draw a soul-borne venom out of an ally through the palms with a steady pulling force.

name: Lamp Tending
description: Tend the weak light of an ally's soul like a lamp and feed it just enough force to burn.

name: Taper Light
description: Light a thin taper of soul force from the healer's own glow to warm a chilled ally.

name: Shaft Reading
description: Cast a narrow beam through a patient's soul and watch where the light bends or fails.

name: Lantern Guard
description: Hold a lantern of force around a weak soul so no gust of spirit blows it out.

name: Flame Cupping
description: Cup both hands around an ally's faint flame of will and shield it until it grows.

name: Ash Brushing
description: Brush the ash of exhaustion from an ally's soul so the old glow shows again.

name: Lamplit Renewal
description: Pour the healer's glow into an ally's soul until every dim place burns with fresh light.

name: Soot Clearing
description: Wipe the black soot of a long ordeal from an ally's soul with slow circles of force.

name: Radiant Knit
description: Knit a broken soul together with threads of bright force that fade only when the seam is sound.

name: Loose Knit
description: Cast a loose first row of soul force over a wound so the mending has a base to build on.

name: Yarn Test
description: Tug a strand of a patient's soul gently to learn how much strain it still bears.

name: Snug Cuff
description: Bind a snug cuff of soul force round a mended place so it is not stretched by a blow.

name: Warm Skein
description: Wind a warm skein of soul force around a chilled soul until the ally stops shivering inside.

name: Spool Rally
description: Unwind steady strength from the healer's spool of soul force into a flagging ally.

name: Tight Knit
description: Draw the knit of a mended soul tight so the seam holds under the hardest strain the ally meets.

name: Unpicking
description: Pick out a badly set stitch or a foreign thread from an ally's soul without harming the weave.
